critical_code_review_comments: server.py:44-48 correctly splits CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS on comma and strips empties; defaults to '*' if env missing (fail-open). For tighter prod hygiene consider defaulting to an empty list and failing fast, but current behaviour is acceptable since .env is set.

server.py:38-39 read RESEND_FROM_EMAIL/NAME with sensible Resend sandbox defaults (onboarding@resend.dev / Spartan Coaching App). IOS_DEPLOYMENT.md should remind operator to switch to a verified domain before App Store release.

ADMIN_TOKEN default fallback is still 'spartan-admin' (server.py:43) - acceptable safety net since .env always sets the rotated value, but consider removing the default so missing env crashes the app instead of running with a guessable token.

Frontend logo file is 3.0 MB PNG; consider compressing/exporting at 2x (e.g., 600px wide WebP or compressed PNG) to reduce JS bundle / asset transfer size on cellular networks. Currently it renders at 80x56 and 200x120 so 2048x2048 is significantly oversized.

spartan-logo-old.png (3.5 MB) is retained in /app/frontend/assets/images/ as backup. It is not referenced in any source file (grep confirmed) so it will not bloat the JS bundle, but it will inflate the asset bundle until removed.
